identity: A short student composition (madrasi essay) praising the UAE's rapid development, its founding sheikhs Zayed bin Sultan and Rashid bin Saeed Al Nahyan, the rise of Dubai, and the state's promotion of women. Register is school-essay MSA with some loose, slightly ungrammatical joins typical of a learner. 143 tokens, ZERO <NL> - a single unbroken paragraph, so prose mode and PASS 2 apply with the NO-CUT default.
law: TOPIC-SPAN (0j) with the post-reversal no-cut default (0i/0p). No line structure means no free boundaries at all: every cut must be earned by a genuine topic change. The essay moves through five topics - (1) the country is developing fast, (2) the founders are the chief contributors, (3) they broke the impossible, (4) what we now see the country has become, (5) Dubai, (6) women - and I cut only at those seams. Every internal connective here is either a subordinator, a bare-NP conjunct, or a masdar, i.e. sub-clausal by 0t and therefore not a candidate.
reasoning: Site @39/@40 'rahimahu Allah wa-al-maghfur lahu al-shaykh Rashid' - a second sheikh joined by wa. Batch-1 me would have cut (A1, and F1's 'each w-conjunct is a unit'). REFUSED: 'wa-al-maghfur lahu...' is a bare NP with no finite verb of its own, so it is sub-clausal and merges by 0t; it is also the same topic (the list of contributors), so 0j merges it too. The two honorific names are one span. Site @50 'fa-hum man bada'u fi kasr hawajiz al-mustahil' - I DO cut before this, at 49. The fa is not why: 0p/0q say fa of explanation attaches. I cut because the preceding nominal sentence ('among the chief contributors are X and Y') is complete and this starts a fresh predication about what they DID, which is a new proposition in the essay's argument, and because the alternative leaves a 46-token unit. Confidence medium - this is the one place I could be over-cutting. Site @70 'hayth asbahat min ahad ahamm al-wijhat' - REFUSED. hayth is now my most heavily evidenced no-cut particle (11 merges on record across doc_4ef3bc70a59e, doc_40e700c4f806, doc_39e47ea428f8, doc_0ad7fe19f9bb, doc_528da1fb596e); a subordinate clause proves the sentence is still running (0p). The following 'wa-min ahamm mahattat' and 'wa-sahibat ahamm madiq' are likewise bare NP conjuncts riding inside the same hayth-clause. Site @88 'ihtimam sumuwwihi al-shaykh Rashid ... bi-imarat Dubai asbahat imara mutatawwira' - asyndetic, and the grammar is loose (a topic phrase with no clean predicate). I cut BEFORE it at 87 because Dubai is a new topic, but I refuse an internal cut at @98 before 'asbahat': 0y says do not punish loose colloquial/learner grammar with extra boundaries, and the whole thing is one thought about Dubai. Site @107 'kama nara anna dawlat al-imarat ihtammat' - I DO cut at 106. This is the one place I overrule 0q's demotion of kama, and deliberately: the kama I demoted (doc_4ef3bc70a59e @117) was mid-sentence elaboration of the same fact, whereas this one opens the essay's final and clearly distinct topic, women's role in society. 0j outranks the particle table in both directions. Site @119 'fa-ja'alat al-dawla min al-mar'a al-imaratiyya wazira' - REFUSED; it is the direct consequence of the attention just described, same topic, and 'waziratan wa-safiratan wa-yawman khassan' are bare NPs while 'ta'zizan wa-bayanan' are masdars - all sub-clausal (0t). The whole women passage is one 36-token unit. SANITY CHECK (v3 step 10): 6 boundaries over 143 tokens = 23.8 tokens per unit, squarely in the 15-25 prose band and far above the sub-8 over-cutting alarm.
